title: चतुःषष्टितमोऽध्यायः

summary.en: Pursuing game, the king enters another forest and comes upon the lovely hermitage of the sage Kanva on the Malini river, filled with the sound of Vedic recitation. He leaves his army and enters with his ministers and priest.
summary.kn: ಬೇಟೆಯನ್ನು ಬೆನ್ನಟ್ಟುತ್ತಾ ರಾಜನು ಇನ್ನೊಂದು ಕಾಡು ಪ್ರವೇಶಿಸಿ ವೇದಘೋಷ ತುಂಬಿದ ಮಾಲಿನೀ ನದೀತೀರದ ಕಣ್ವ ಮಹರ್ಷಿಯ ರಮ್ಯ ಆಶ್ರಮಕ್ಕೆ ಬರುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಸೈನ್ಯವನ್ನು ಬಿಟ್ಟು ಮಂತ್ರಿ ಪುರೋಹಿತರೊಂದಿಗೆ ಒಳಹೋಗುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: शिकार का पीछा करते हुए राजा दूसरे वन में पहुँचकर मालिनी नदी के तट पर वेदपाठ से गूँजते कण्व ऋषि के सुन्दर आश्रम में आते हैं। वे सेना को छोड़कर मन्त्रियों और पुरोहित के साथ भीतर जाते हैं।
summary.te: వేటను వెంబడిస్తూ రాజు మరో అడవిలోకి ప్రవేశించి వేదఘోషతో నిండిన మాలినీ నదీతీరంలోని కణ్వమహర్షి రమ్యమైన ఆశ్రమానికి వస్తాడు. సైన్యాన్ని విడిచి మంత్రులు, పురోహితునితో లోపలికి వెళ్తాడు.
summary.ta: வேட்டையைப் பின்தொடர்ந்த மன்னன் மற்றொரு காட்டில் நுழைந்து, வேத ஒலி நிறைந்த மாலினி நதிக்கரையிலுள்ள கண்வ முனிவரின் அழகிய ஆசிரமத்தை அடைகிறான். படையை விட்டு அமைச்சர்கள், புரோகிதருடன் உள்ளே செல்கிறான்.
summary.ml: മൃഗത്തെ പിന്തുടർന്ന് രാജാവ് മറ്റൊരു കാട്ടിലെത്തുന്നു; മാലിനിനദിക്കരയിലെ കണ്വ ഋഷിയുടെ മനോഹരമായ ആശ്രമം വേദപാരായണശബ്ദങ്ങളാൽ നിറഞ്ഞിരിക്കുന്നു. അദ്ദേഹം സൈന്യത്തെ പുറത്തുനിർത്തി, മന്ത്രിമാരോടും പുരോഹിതനോടുമൊപ്പം അകത്ത് പ്രവേശിക്കുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 1.64; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Thu Aug 22 2026

verses.text: वैशंपायन उवाच

meaning.en: Vaishampayana said:

verses.text:
ततो मृगसहस्राणि हत्वा विपुलवाहनः ।
राजा मृगप्रसङ्गेन वनमन्यद्विवेश ह ॥

meaning.en: Then the king, with his great train of vehicles, having killed thousands of animals, entered another forest in pursuit of game.

verses.text:
एक एवोत्तमबलः क्षुत्पिपासासमन्वितः ।
स वनस्यान्तमासाद्य महदीरिणमासदत् ॥

meaning.en: Alone, of great strength, but afflicted by hunger and thirst, he reached the end of that forest and came to a vast desert.

verses.text:
तच्चाप्यतीत्य नृपतिरुत्तमाश्रमसंयुतम् ।
मनःप्रह्लादजननं दृष्टिकान्तमतीव च ।
शीतमारुतसंयुक्तं जगामान्यन्महद्वनम् ॥

meaning.en: Passing even that, the king came to another great forest that held a splendid hermitage, delighting the mind, very pleasing to the eye, and blessed with a cool breeze.

verses.text:
पुष्पितैः पादपैः कीर्णमतीव सुखशाद्वलम् ।
विपुलं मधुरारावैर्नादितं विहगैस्तथा ॥

meaning.en: It was strewn with flowering trees, with pleasant grass underfoot, spacious, and resounding with the sweet cries of birds.

verses.text:
प्रवृद्धविटपैर्वृक्षैः सुखच्छायैः समावृतम् ।
षट्पदाघूर्णितलतं लक्ष्म्या परमया युतम् ॥

meaning.en: It was filled with trees with spreading branches and pleasant shade, its creepers swaying with bees, and endowed with supreme beauty.

verses.text:
नापुष्पः पादपः कश्चिन्नाफलो नापि कण्टकी ।
षट्पदैर्वाप्यनाकीर्णस्तस्मिन्वै काननेऽभवत् ॥

meaning.en: In that forest there was no tree without flowers, none without fruit, none that was thorny, and none unvisited by bees.

verses.text:
विहगैर्नादितं पुष्पैरलंकृतमतीव च ।
सर्वर्तुकुसुमैर्वृक्षैरतीव सुखशाद्वलम् ।
मनोरमं महेष्वासो विवेश वनमुत्तमम् ॥

meaning.en: Resounding with birds and adorned with flowers, with trees that bore blossoms in every season and very pleasant grass, the great archer entered that delightful, excellent forest.

verses.text:
मारुतागलितास्तत्र द्रुमाः कुसुमशालिनः ।
पुष्पवृष्टिं विचित्रां स्म व्यसृजंस्ते पुनः पुनः ॥

meaning.en: There the flowering trees, shaken by the wind, shed a wondrous rain of blossoms again and again.

verses.text:
दिवस्पृशोऽथ संघुष्टाः पक्षिभिर्मधुरस्वरैः ।
विरेजुः पादपास्तत्र विचित्रकुसुमाम्बराः ॥

meaning.en: Touching the sky and resounding with the sweet voices of birds, the trees there shone, clothed in garments of many-colored flowers.

verses.text:
तेषां तत्र प्रवालेषु पुष्पभारावनामिषु ।
रुवन्ति रावं विहगाः षट्पदैः सहिता मृदु ॥

meaning.en: On their shoots, bent low with the weight of flowers, birds sang softly along with the bees.

verses.text:
तत्र प्रदेशांश्च बहून्कुसुमोत्करमण्डितान् ।
लतागृहपरिक्षिप्तान्मनसः प्रीतिवर्धनान् ।
संपश्यन्स महातेजा बभूव मुदितस्तदा ॥

meaning.en: Seeing many spots there adorned with heaps of blossoms, surrounded by bowers of creepers and raising the mind's delight, the greatly radiant king was glad.

verses.text:
परस्पराश्लिष्टशाखैः पादपैः कुसुमाचितैः ।
अशोभत वनं तत्तैर्महेन्द्रध्वजसंनिभैः ॥

meaning.en: With trees whose branches were intertwined and heaped with flowers, that forest looked like banners raised for Indra.

verses.text:
सुखशीतः सुगन्धी च पुष्परेणुवहोऽनिलः ।
परिक्रामन्वने वृक्षानुपैतीव रिरंसया ॥

meaning.en: The wind, pleasantly cool and fragrant, carrying the pollen of flowers, wandered through the forest as if it wished to play with the trees.

verses.text:
एवंगुणसमायुक्तं ददर्श स वनं नृपः ।
नदीकच्छोद्भवं कान्तमुच्छ्रितध्वजसंनिभम् ॥

meaning.en: The king saw the forest, endowed with such qualities, lovely, rising from the river's bank, like a raised banner.

verses.text:
प्रेक्षमाणो वनं तत्तु सुप्रहृष्टविहंगमम् ।
आश्रमप्रवरं रम्यं ददर्श च मनोरमम् ॥

meaning.en: Looking at that forest where the birds were so delighted, he saw an excellent, delightful and charming hermitage.

verses.text:
नानावृक्षसमाकीर्णं संप्रज्वलितपावकम् ।
यतिभिर्वालखिल्यैश्च वृतं मुनिगणान्वितम् ॥

meaning.en: It was thick with many kinds of trees, its sacrificial fires blazing, surrounded by ascetics and Valakhilyas, and filled with companies of sages.

verses.text:
अग्न्यागारैश्च बहुभिः पुष्पसंस्तरसंस्तृतम् ।
महाकच्छैर्बृहद्भिश्च विभ्राजितमतीव च ॥

meaning.en: With many fire-houses, spread with beds of flowers, and with its great, wide banks, it shone brightly.

verses.text:
मालिनीमभितो राजन्नदीं पुण्यां सुखोदकाम् ।
नैकपक्षिगणाकीर्णां तपोवनमनोरमाम् ।
तत्र व्यालमृगान्सौम्यान्पश्यन्प्रीतिमवाप सः ॥

meaning.en: King, he saw the sacred river Malini nearby, with pleasant water, thronged with many flocks of birds, charming as an ascetic forest. There, seeing gentle wild beasts, he felt joy.

verses.text:
तं चाप्यतिरथः श्रीमानाश्रमं प्रत्यपद्यत ।
देवलोकप्रतीकाशं सर्वतः सुमनोहरम् ॥

meaning.en: And the glorious great chariot-warrior approached that hermitage, like a place in the world of the gods, utterly charming on every side.

verses.text:
नदीमाश्रमसंश्लिष्टां पुण्यतोयां ददर्श सः ।
सर्वप्राणभृतां तत्र जननीमिव विष्ठिताम् ॥

meaning.en: He saw the river with holy water joined to the hermitage, standing there like a mother of all living beings.

verses.text:
सचक्रवाकपुलिनां पुष्पफेनप्रवाहिनीम् ।
सकिंनरगणावासां वानरर्क्षनिषेविताम् ॥

meaning.en: It had sandbanks with chakravaka birds, and carried a flowery foam; it was a dwelling for troops of kinnaras, frequented by monkeys and bears.

verses.text:
पुण्यस्वाध्यायसंघुष्टां पुलिनैरुपशोभिताम् ।
मत्तवारणशार्दूलभुजगेन्द्रनिषेविताम् ॥

meaning.en: It resounded with holy Vedic study, adorned by its sandbanks, and visited by rutting elephants, tigers and great serpents.

verses.text:
नदीमाश्रमसंबद्धां दृष्ट्वाश्रमपदं तथा ।
चकाराभिप्रवेशाय मतिं स नृपतिस्तदा ॥

meaning.en: Seeing the river joined to the hermitage, and the hermitage itself, the king then resolved to enter.

verses.text:
अलंकृतं द्वीपवत्या मालिन्या रम्यतीरया ।
नरनारायणस्थानं गङ्गयेवोपशोभितम् ।
मत्तबर्हिणसंघुष्टं प्रविवेश महद्वनम् ॥

meaning.en: Adorned by the Malini with its islands and lovely banks, like the abode of Nara and Narayana made beautiful by the Ganga, and resounding with rutting peacocks, he entered that great forest.

verses.text:
तत्स चैत्ररथप्रख्यं समुपेत्य नरेश्वरः ।
अतीव गुणसंपन्नमनिर्देश्यं च वर्चसा ।
महर्षिं काश्यपं द्रष्टुमथ कण्वं तपोधनम् ॥

meaning.en: Coming to that place, which was like the Chaitraratha garden, endowed with extraordinary qualities and beyond description in splendor, the lord of men went to see the great sage Kanva Kashyapa, rich in austerity.

verses.text:
रथिनीमश्वसंबाधां पदातिगणसंकुलाम् ।
अवस्थाप्य वनद्वारि सेनामिदमुवाच सः ॥

meaning.en: He halted his army, with its chariots and crowded with horses and masses of foot soldiers, at the forest gate, and said:

verses.text:
मुनिं विरजसं द्रष्टुं गमिष्यामि तपोधनम् ।
काश्यपं स्थीयतामत्र यावदागमनं मम ॥

meaning.en: "I will go to see the sage Kashyapa, rich in austerity and free of passion. Stay here until I come back."

verses.text:
तद्वनं नन्दनप्रख्यमासाद्य मनुजेश्वरः ।
क्षुत्पिपासे जहौ राजा हर्षं चावाप पुष्कलम् ॥

meaning.en: Reaching that forest, like Nandana, the lord of men shed his hunger and thirst, and felt abundant joy.

verses.text:
सामात्यो राजलिङ्गानि सोऽपनीय नराधिपः ।
पुरोहितसहायश्च जगामाश्रममुत्तमम् ।
दिदृक्षुस्तत्र तमृषिं तपोराशिमथाव्ययम् ॥

meaning.en: Together with his minister, the king removed his royal insignia and went to that excellent hermitage with his priest, wishing to see the sage, a mass of austerity, imperishable.

verses.text:
ब्रह्मलोकप्रतीकाशमाश्रमं सोऽभिवीक्ष्य च ।
षट्पदोद्गीतसंघुष्टं नानाद्विजगणायुतम् ॥

meaning.en: Looking at the hermitage, which resembled the world of Brahma, resounding with the humming of bees and filled with many flocks of birds,

verses.text:
ऋचो बह्वृचमुख्यैश्च प्रेर्यमाणाः पदक्रमैः ।
शुश्राव मनुजव्याघ्रो विततेष्विह कर्मसु ॥

meaning.en: that tiger among men heard verses of the Rig Veda recited by chief reciters of many hymns, with the word-by-word and sequence readings, in the rites being performed.

verses.text:
यज्ञविद्याङ्गविद्भिश्च क्रमद्भिश्च क्रमानपि ।
अमितात्मभिः सुनियतैः शुशुभे स तदाश्रमः ॥

meaning.en: That hermitage shone with disciplined people of boundless spirit, knowers of sacrifice and the branches of learning, who recited in the proper sequence.

verses.text:
अथर्ववेदप्रवराः पूगयाज्ञिक संमताः ।
संहितामीरयन्ति स्म पदक्रमयुतां तु ते ॥

meaning.en: The best of Atharva Veda scholars, honored by groups of sacrificers, recited the collection with its word and sequence readings.

verses.text:
शब्दसंस्कारसंयुक्तं ब्रुवद्भिश्चापरैर्द्विजैः ।
नादितः स बभौ श्रीमान्ब्रह्मलोक इवाश्रमः ॥

meaning.en: Resounding with other brahmins who spoke the refinements of language, the glorious hermitage looked like the world of Brahma.

verses.text:
यज्ञसंस्कारविद्भिश्च क्रमशिक्षा विशारदैः ।
न्यायतत्त्वार्थविज्ञानसंपन्नैर्वेदपारगैः ॥

meaning.en: There were those who knew the sacrificial rites and were skilled in the teaching of sequence, accomplished in logic and the true sense of things, masters of the Veda,

verses.text:
नानावाक्यसमाहारसमवायविशारदैः ।
विशेषकार्यविद्भिश्च मोक्षधर्मपरायणैः ॥

meaning.en: skilled in combining and organizing many statements, knowers of special rites, devoted to the dharma of liberation,

verses.text:
स्थापनाक्षेपसिद्धान्तपरमार्थज्ञतां गतैः ।
लोकायतिकमुख्यैश्च समन्तादनुनादितम् ॥

meaning.en: reaching the highest truth through setting up, objecting and concluding, and by chief logicians, it echoed on every side.

verses.text:
तत्र तत्र च विप्रेन्द्रान्नियतान्संशितव्रतान् ।
जपहोमपरान्सिद्धान्ददर्श परवीरहा ॥

meaning.en: Here and there the slayer of enemy heroes saw excellent brahmins, restrained, strict in vows, devoted to chanting and offerings, accomplished.

verses.text:
आसनानि विचित्राणि पुष्पवन्ति महीपतिः ।
प्रयत्नोपहितानि स्म दृष्ट्वा विस्मयमागमत् ॥

meaning.en: The king, seeing seats of many colors, strewn with flowers and carefully set out, was filled with wonder.

verses.text:
देवतायतनानां च पूजां प्रेक्ष्य कृतां द्विजैः ।
ब्रह्मलोकस्थमात्मानं मेने स नृपसत्तमः ॥

meaning.en: Seeing the worship made by the brahmins at the shrines of the gods, that best of kings felt himself to be in the world of Brahma.

verses.text:
स काश्यपतपोगुप्तमाश्रमप्रवरं शुभम् ।
नातृप्यत्प्रेक्षमाणो वै तपोधनगणैर्युतम् ॥

meaning.en: He could not get enough of seeing that excellent, auspicious hermitage, guarded by the austerity of Kashyapa and filled with hosts of ascetics.

verses.text:
स काश्यपस्यायतनं महाव्रतै-
र्वृतं समन्तादृषिभिस्तपोधनैः ।
विवेश सामात्यपुरोहितोऽरिहा
विविक्तमत्यर्थमनोहरं शिवम् ॥

meaning.en: Together with his minister and priest, the slayer of foes entered that dwelling of Kashyapa, surrounded on every side by sages of great vows and rich in austerity, secluded, exceedingly charming and peaceful.
